name: bulkhead
description: Hooks for running many Claude Code sessions on one machine.

plugins.name: bulkhead
plugins.description: Blocks name-based kills, port collisions, whole-disk and parallel scans, long foreground sleeps, and git commands that would move, sweep up or delete another session's tree; budgets RAM for heavy commands; stops what exited sessions leave running; and replays your past transcripts with bulkhead scan.
